content: Proper name identification can be solved by characteristics. For example, systems use beginning characters of proper names which are uppercase characters. Moreover, a list of proper names is also used to identify names in the text. In particular, a list of 2000 personal names extracted from VietnamGiaPha, and a list of 707 names of locations in Vietnam extracted from vi.wikipedia.org are used in the study of Nguyen et al. for Vietnamese word segmentation BIBREF7 .
